title: [review] router.rs:926: GPSR strict less-than excludes
description: In gpsr_forward, the comparison 'd < best_dist' means if a neighbor is at exactly the destination coordinates (d=0) and we're at the destination (best_dist=0), the neighbor won't be selected. In the degenerate case where multiple nodes share coordinates, this could prevent forwarding to a valid next hop. Using '<=' would be more robust.
